limits_and_causal_disposition: The first sentence exists only as speculative interim text on the observed wire, not as an authoritative final discarded by SDK or product.
No authoritative-text decoding drop, adapter drop or engine drop is observed in the valid session. Thus no smallest product repair target exists on that boundary.

The extra bounded receive period produced no messages/finals. This probe does not demonstrate a two-second drain timing gap; it also does not establish any guaranteed deadline or completeness contract.
Absence on wire until cleanup is only bounded-session absence, not proof of a service implementation bug, causal explanation of every old run, or eventual non-arrival after close.
Client send return accounts actual submitted bytes, not remote semantic acceptance or an input-final acknowledgement.
Voice-activity offsets are retained but do not qualify a final-to-capture clock or speaker correspondence. Rich attribution remains separate from final-content coverage.
No public audio beyond the existing clean_A_B was used. No other provider, paid translation, Nemotron, VRChat/SteamVR, arbitrary web search, product/docs edit or Git mutation occurred.

No further live call is needed for the observed disposition. A provider-side minimal reproduction/contract clarification would be the next information source if the Director pursues complete-final qualification. This report does not authorize GitHub publication.
